reviewer: run_v2_motion_guides subagent; also authored the late images, so this is a critical self-review, not independent external validation
coordinate_precision: Positions and displacements below are approximate visual estimates at native 1536x1024, not measured motion capture or automated pixel correspondences.

verdict.single_frame_anatomy: Reviewed photographs generally have four identifiable limbs and plausible fore elbows / hind hocks. This does not validate timing, foot trajectories, weight transfer or continuity.
verdict.continuity: The reviewed sequence still has visible pose jumps, head reversals and motion holds. Do not describe this version as a verified natural continuous run.

prioritized_repairs.issue: Forelegs remain almost unchanged through 001-005, then visible near forepaw jumps about 120 px forward in 005→006. In 007→008 the near foreleg curls back roughly 130 px while the far foreleg takes the forward slot. This looks like a near/far pose swap rather than a continuous arc.
prioritized_repairs.practical_repair: Regenerate 005-008 progressively from preceding selected photographs, explicitly preserving the same near/far limb identity and advancing each forepaw on one continuous unfolding arc. Retain distinct hind contact timings. Review actual adjacent photos before selection.

prioritized_repairs.issue: Head/body timing reverses and then holds: approximate muzzle y 515→527→502 across 033→034→035. Visible near forepaw jumps left/up about 40-45 px in 037→038, then 039-041 hardly advance; 041→042 moves the whole dog down about 15-20 px. Hindpaws barely advance through most of 033-041.
prioritized_repairs.practical_repair: Correct 034 head height against 033 and 035; regenerate the late gathering/settling progression with small distributed body and foot changes, preserving 042→001 endpoint alignment. Each adjacent pair must show coherent limb speed rather than long holds followed by a large correction.

additional_observations.finding: Near hindpaw descends progressively, but head/trunk/tail and both forelegs are effectively held. This limits whole-body running impression.
Far hindpaw drops approximately 40-50 px into contact and tail/chest lower abruptly. These compound the foreleg jump.

Visible near forepaw generally rises, with uneven spacing and a horizontal reversal around 034→035. Far forepaw moves down around 034→035 before rising again. The far-leg trajectory is less coherent than the individual anatomy.

Dog pose/head/paws are fairly close at the endpoint, but the late photographs have cooler and more detailed gray floor texture whereas 001 has warmer, smoother studio background/floor. This can create a loop flash.
Within 033-042 camera crop and floor horizon remain broadly consistent; fur and texture differ slightly between generated photographs.

limitations: Review covers only 001-008 and 033-042 plus loop closure, not the middle cycle or browser playback.
Guide validation checks authored pose controls, not actual AI-generated joint motion.
No photographs, guides, receipts or candidate originals were changed by this review.
summary_ko: 개별 사진의 관절은 대체로 자연스럽지만, 앞발의 갑작스러운 이동과 머리 높이의 역전, 후반부의 정지에 가까운 구간 때문에 연속 달리기의 자연스러움은 아직 검증되지 않았습니다.
summary_en: Individual photographs mostly have plausible joints, but abrupt forepaw moves, head-height reversals and late motion holds prevent verification of natural continuous running.
